get.description: Global operational metrics require an unrestricted read token; source-scoped read credentials receive 403. Token must be unrestricted across both sources and indices. Storage diagnostics include bounded index labels.

Bounded sequence-based SSE. Without Last-Event-ID starts at current committed highwater. Includes late arrivals. log frames contain canonical Event JSON and id; cursor frames advance id when caught up. gap/error frames terminate stream: reconcile retained history before reconnecting. Expired resume IDs emit a terminal gap; retention expiry conservatively invalidates IDs below the highest removed ingestion ID across all sources. Slow subscribers cannot block ingestion. IDs are decimal strings, distinct from opaque search cursors. All query filters are applied on the server before output buffering. Retained replay pages drain immediately; backlog length alone never emits a gap. Each subscriber has a configured outbound byte budget; an oversized retained/imported event returns 413 before streaming starts or emits a terminal gap once streaming has started. Commit notifications wake live subscribers with periodic polling as fallback.

413.description: A retained event exceeds the subscriber output byte budget before streaming starts

Includes late arrivals. log frames contain canonical Event JSON and id; cursor frames advance id when caught up. gap/error frames terminate stream: reconcile retained history before reconnecting. Expired resume IDs emit a terminal gap; retention expiry conservatively invalidates IDs below the highest removed ingestion ID across all sources. Slow subscribers cannot block ingestion. Authenticated ingestion may create a missing index within max_indexes; reads never create indices. SSE frame IDs and Last-Event-ID use <index>:<decimal event ID>; event JSON id remains a decimal string.

delete.description: Permanently delete a dynamic index and its events. Requires a separate admin token. The default index and indexes declared in server configuration are protected. An admitted deletion drains native workers and finishes independently of client disconnection. Producers can recreate a deleted index on subsequent ingestion; stop producers first when removing an index permanently.

IndexInfo.description: Name is always included. Fresh physical file sizes, policy and readiness are included for admin tokens and readers unrestricted by source. Source-scoped readers receive only the name. Measurements can change during concurrent activity and count logical file lengths, not allocated filesystem blocks.
